newsitem.title: USA: BPA drops Wed peak firm power to $15.00-16.00/MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA drops Wed peak firm power to $15.00-16.00/MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) again offered 300 megawatts of peak firm power for Wednesday delivery, while cutting prices by another $4.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Tuesday.

BPA offered peak firm power during heavy load hours on Wednesday at $15.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest sales, down from $19.00 for Tuesday deliveries, and at $16.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales, compared with $20.00 for Tuesday.
For Tuesday, BPA had dropped prices for peak firm power by $11.00 to 12.00.
For Wednesday, BPA continued to offer unlimited peak firm power during light load hours at $9.00 a MWh.
Wednesday non-firm power from hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 was also unchanged at $9.00 for all deliveries, while deliveries during hours ending 0600 and 2300 were offered at $10.00.
